# HIR Industries

> Manufacturer of tile adhesives, epoxy grouts, waterproofing systems, wall solutions and construction chemicals. Serving India, Middle East, USA, UK, Australia, South-East Asia and Africa since 1972.

HIR Industries builds high-performance construction chemicals engineered with German-American-Japanese technology. Product ranges include C1 to C2TES2-grade tile adhesives, epoxy and cement grouts, elastomeric waterproofing membranes, block jointers, wall putty, heat-reflective coatings and professional installation tools.
